name.en-US: The Virtues of a Religious Superior (De sex alis Seraphim)
name.pt-BR: As virtudes de um superior religioso (As seis asas do Serafim)

description.en-US: Sabinus Mollitor’s 1920 English translation of St. Bonaventure’s De sex alis Seraphim: the six wings of the seraph as six virtues of a religious superior, in a prologue and seven chapters (the Latin text of the Quaracchi edition is in the separate book bonaventure-de-sex-alis-seraphim, whose chapters run II-IV together). The translator’s sub-headings and notes are left out.
description.pt-BR: Tradução inglesa de Sabinus Mollitor (1920) de «As seis asas do Serafim», de São Boaventura: as seis asas do serafim como seis virtudes de um superior religioso.

sources.edition: The Virtues of a Religious Superior, by St. Bonaventure, translated from the Latin by Sabinus Mollitor, O.F.M. (St. Louis and London: B. Herder, 1920).
sources.description: Prologue, seven chapters and the conclusion of the translation. Paragraph numbers are kept; running heads and footnotes are dropped; words split at line ends are rejoined with a dictionary, so a few slips remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in 1920, before 1931: public domain in the US.

title.en-US: Chapter I. The selection of superiors
